$comment: Prosary editorial calendar display labels, scoped to the Syriac feast calendar. These are ordinary saint names and observance metadata, not official prayer or liturgical translations. English Evangelizo identities retain precedence; titles do not alter dates, rank, saint identity or biographies. Reviewed Arabic/Hebrew labels support name disambiguation, without replacing a differing English source name, number or epithet. Conventional vernacular names are used where known; uncertain proper names are retained or transliterated conservatively. Selected exact identities reuse existing credited feast-title catalogs; no fuzzy or date-based matching is used.
